name: Larch Valley to Sentinel Pass
parking_or_shuttle: Moraine Lake shuttle required (Parks Canada shuttle, reserve; see moraine-lake sight)
child_note: Too long and steep for a 6 year old (11.2 km return, 750 m).
less_walking_alternative: Moraine Lake canoe or Rockpile viewpoint
sept_notes: Larches turn late Sept (blog: peak about 20-30 Sept, so early Sept is usually too early, green); snow possible above treeline any time. Trail listed with no closure on Parks Canada page.
hazards: Grizzly and black bear country; carry bear spray, group travel recommended. Group-of-four restriction for Larch Valley area in late summer: GAP (official Moraine Lake page returned 404), INFERENCE only.

name: Plain of Six Glaciers (to teahouse and Abbot Pass viewpoint)

sept_notes: Teahouse open in summer: operating dates GAP. Snow possible.
hazards: Avalanche debris and exposed sections near end: GAP.

name: Rawson Lake
trailhead: Rawson Lake trailhead, Upper Kananaskis Lake
parking_or_shuttle: Day-use lot; KCP needed. No shuttle.
child_note: About 4 km one way with 300 m gain; a fit 6 year old may manage with breaks, but 2026 grizzly-with-cubs advisory (effective July 5) is a key risk.
less_walking_alternative: Walk Interlakes trail or lakeshore at Lower Lake instead.
sept_notes: Larches turn mid-Sept to early Oct (Alberta Parks); varies by year; first snow possible. Sources do not confirm larches at Rawson (lower confidence). Kananaskis Conservation Pass needed to park (2026: C$15/day/vehicle, C$90/yr).
hazards: Grizzly and black bears; carry bear spray, keep child close, hike in a tight group. 2026 advisories closed or restricted Rawson/Sarrail and the Upper Lake circuit for grizzly with cubs.

name: Sarrail Ridge
trailhead: Rawson Lake trailhead, Upper Kananaskis Lake
child_note: Steep final gully (close to 400 m in just over 1 km); too hard for 6 year old.
less_walking_alternative: Rawson Lake only, or Interlakes trail.
sept_notes: Larches turn mid-Sept to early Oct (Alberta Parks); varies by year; first snow possible. Kananaskis Conservation Pass needed to park (2026: C$15/day/vehicle, C$90/yr).
hazards: Steep slippery gully; exposed; grizzly advisory.

name: Interlakes Trail (Upper and Lower Lake)

less_walking_alternative: Short lakeside walks at Lower Lake day use.
sept_notes: Kananaskis Conservation Pass needed to park (2026: C$15/day/vehicle, C$90/yr). Upper Lake circuit shoreline was closed 2026 for grizzlies; check.
hazards: Bears; bikes allowed on part of trail.
